Translate business needs into clear requirements for BAT Engineering, and own functional testing and sign-off. - Protect billing integrity. Make sure what's sold, what's contracted, and what's billed stay in sync. Treat data quality, controls, and audit trails as part of the job. - Own vendor relationships. Manage key O2C vendors, including performance against SLAs, licence usage, and input into renewals with Procurement. - Support tooling decisions. Contribute to evaluations of off-the-shelf CPQ and CLM options, and to buy-versus-build decisions. - Enable and mentor. Train business users on new processes, peer review colleagues' work, and support analysts on the team. To put things into context, we currently have multi-entity, multi-currency quoting and billing for enterprise contracts and the next generation of quote-to-cash tooling on our roadmap. You can expect to work with the following tech stack: HubSpot Quoting, our pricing calculator and CPQ, DocuSign, Zuora, and NetSuite. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: - 8+ years in business applications, with deep experience across quote-to-cash or order-to-cash systems. - Hands-on experience with CPQ, billing, and ERP platforms, such as Zuora, NetSuite, Salesforce CPQ, HubSpot Quotes, Chargebee, or similar. You understand how they connect. - Solid knowledge of SaaS commercial processes, including pricing and packaging, discounting and approvals, contracts, subscription billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition basics. - Product ownership experience: roadmaps, backlogs, prioritisation frameworks, and saying no with a reason. - Strong stakeholder management. You can hold competing priorities from Finance, Sales, and Deal Desk in one conversation and get to a decision. - Experience leading delivery in Agile teams, including user stories, sprints, UAT, and release management. - Excellent written and spoken English.
